programmes.structure_summary: Generic CS master's of the Tsinghua CS department with three second-level disciplines (computer architecture, software and theory, applied computing). Students need >= 28 degree credits: public compulsory courses, compulsory components (literature review and proposal, academic activities, academic/professional skills) and >= 20 credits of subject courses, including at least one 'professional foundation course' of the chosen discipline. The computer-architecture list contains Parallel Computing, an HPC lab course, parallel programming for computational science and engineering, network storage, distributed systems and big-data systems; no course is mandatory except one foundation course.

programmes.structure_summary: Generic CS master's with four second-level disciplines. The computer-architecture track lists High-level Computer Architecture (mandatory) plus Parallel Algorithms, Advanced Computer Networks, Advanced Operating Systems and Introduction to Quantum Computing as professional-foundation courses (at least one). Professional electives include Parallel Programming (3.5), Parallel Compiler Techniques, Storage and File Systems, Edge and Cloud Computing, Computer Systems Modelling and Simulation, Intelligent Computing Systems and Virtual Machine principles. High Performance Computing (COMP7201P) is listed only as a doctoral course.

programmes.structure_summary: The college lists 'computer systems architecture and parallel computing' and 'distributed processing and grid services' among the research directions of its computer-architecture discipline. Only two graduate syllabi with HPC-relevant content are online: Advanced Computer Architecture (3 credits, 54 hours; ILP, thread-level parallelism, cache design, multiprocessor synchronisation and consistency, interconnects and cluster computers) and Grid Computing (2 credits, 36 hours, elective). The 2023 graduate programme (course list and credit breakdown) is hosted on a domain that did not resolve, so the actual current course list is unknown.
